item: penalty clean-up: remove the old 2^(k-1) mistake ladder completely (Moshe: "אין צורך להוסיף בהגדרות, זה היה חישוב לא הגיוני")
summary:
The old mistake ladder is now gone from the code, the tests and the docs. Every wrong digit always costs the missed points (§6.5).

Engine:
- `doublingPenalty` is deleted from scoring.ts.
- The `MistakePenaltyRule` type and the `rules.mistakePenalty` field and its default are deleted from rules.ts.
- The rules.ts header now says D14 is not a field because Moshe closed it. The scoreY doc notes that Y also prices a mistake.
- In engine.ts, `wrongDigitPenalty(s, cell)` has no 'doubling' branch and no mistake-number argument. It always returns `missedPoints(s.grid, cell, solution[cell], rules.scoreY).points`.
- `mistakePenalties` in state and view stays, because the pips use it.

Protocol and server: they already had no `mistakePenaltyCap` and no `mistakePenalty`. The strict rulesSchema still refuses both keys, and the tests prove it.

Replay:
- Old games used to be told apart by `rules.mistakePenalty === 'missedPoints'`. That field no longer exists, so new logs and old logs look the same in their rules.
- `buildReplay` now works it out from the log's own data, in a new field `Replay.penaltiesAreMissedPoints`. It is true only when every placedWrong penalty equals `missedPoints` on the board before that move.
- An old game always fails this: under the ladder each player's first mistake cost 1, and missed points are never below 1.5 (a new test checks this). So none of an old game's wrong moves gets a penalty line, even when a later ladder value happens to equal missed points.
- `penaltyLine` comes from a new helper, `missedPointsOf(states, step, scoreY)`. `gridBefore` was split into `gridBeforeIn(states, s)` plus a wrapper.

Docs:
- 01-SPEC §6.5: the config/alternative bullet is replaced. The rule applies in every mode; there is no setting and no alternative, by Moshe's explicit request of 15.10.2026; the ladder and the D14 cap are deleted; old games keep their recorded penalties.
- 01-SPEC §13.2 now says how an old game is recognised. The §24 D14 alternative column now reads "אין: משה ביקש לא להשאיר את השיטה הישנה כאפשרות, והיא נמחקה".
- DECISIONS-PENDING 2.2: the old method is deleted completely at Moshe's request, the "איפה" line is updated, and there is a note on how old games are recognised.
- 02-WORK-PLAN: the stage-1 scoring bullet and the "סיום" bullet are updated.
- components.md (pips row): a note that the design boards still show −1/−2 sample values from the removed ladder.
- QA-CHECKLIST, motion.md and RELEASE-CHECKLIST already described only the new rule, so they needed no change.
- 00-original-spec-v1.md was not touched.

item: black-screen: no black or empty screen at the end of an online game (the opponent gives up or leaves mid-game, or I give up), client and server
summary:
Built both designs (black-client and black-server), following DECISIONS.md. No engine or protocol change, and no ENGINE_VERSION or PROTOCOL_VERSION bump.

CLIENT
- Hold before the results: `endDelayMs(reason, reduce, online)`.
  - Online ends other than a full board (a surrender by either player, an abandonment, an end that arrives in a reconnection snapshot) hold the final board for `ONLINE_END_HOLD_MS` = 600 ms, or 200 ms with Reduced Motion.
  - A full board still holds 1100/200. A practice end is still 0 ms plus the dialog's exit.
  - Values are in the new `apps/mobile/src/config/gameEnd.ts` (`onlineHoldMs` 600, `resultsWatchdogMs` 4000, `fallbackActionsMs` 1500).
- The results always open from a timer of the screen: `showResults` → `later()`, also for 0 ms. They never open inside the host or WebSocket callback, a press or a render. The same applies to the "already over" effect (which now also holds) and to "לתוצאות".
- Lock ring and seconds pill: the Reanimated `exiting={FadeOut}` layout animations are removed from `Cell.tsx`.
  - They are replaced by a fade that does not depend on navigation: `useLeaving` keeps the part mounted, and `useLastLook` keeps the last look of the ring or pill while its opacity fades.
  - Timing: 240 ms, or 200 ms with Reduced Motion (the app setting is now honoured). A JS safety timer covers the end of the fade, and a new lock on the cell takes over the fading copy.
  - The derived state lives in LockRing and SecondsPill, not CellView, so the per-tick render counts in GameScreenRenders are unchanged.
  - New static guard `noLayoutAnimationsInGame.test.ts`.
- Native modals:
  - `Sheet` has an `onExited` prop, and ReportSheet forwards it.
  - `useModerationFlow` now returns `mounted` and `closeAll()`, and takes an `onExited` option.
  - `GameScreen` waits for the end dialog and the moderation sheet or dialog (`whenModalsGone`) and closes them before the results. The `blocked` adjust-in-render also closes them.
- Never an empty screen: new `screens/FlowFallback.tsx` with i18n `common:fallback.*` in he and en.
  - It shows a spinner and "רגע…", then after 1.5 s "המסך לא נטען" with "לתוצאות" (optional) and "לבית". Android back goes home, and it sends one non-fatal report.
  - It is used in `app/game.tsx` (no session; the practice GameScreen now also gets `onHome`), `app/match/index.tsx` (no search), MatchScreen's `cancelled` state, and GameScreen when my seat is missing.
- Results watchdog: GameScreen takes a `resultsWatchdogMs` prop (default 4000).
  - If the screen is still mounted that long after `onEnded`, it records the non-fatal 'game: results watchdog' and shows FlowFallback (`results-fallback`) over everything. "לתוצאות" re-arms it.
- The reconnect loop stops after the end: `RemoteGameHost.dropConnection()` on a game that is over now calls `shutdown('gameOver')`. This covers silence, gaps and send failures, so there is no reconnect or join against a finished room.
- Release diagnostics:
  - `RemoteHostDeps.report` and `MatchmakingClientDeps.report` are called next to the existing log on 'listener failed', 'online listener failed' and 'message failed'.
  - `net/device.ts` (`onlineLog`) and `net/matchmakingDevice.ts` (`matchmakingLog`) send log lines to `crashReporter().log` with `[online]` / `[matchmaking]` prefixes. Reports go to `recordError` with the context 'online: …' or 'matchmaking: …'.
  - The matchmaking 'found' log line now carries ratings only, no names (PII).
  - GameScreen breadcrumbs: `game over (<reason>) locks=N modal=B hit=B`, `results in N ms[, after the dialogs]`, `game over on arrival (<reason>)`. The results route logs on mount.

SERVER (`GameRoom.ts`)
- A finished room now tracks `sawEnd`: players who were connected at gameOver or came back since, via `welcomeBack`.
- `autoDispose` is set to `everyoneSawEnd()` instead of `true`, and `closeAt` = gameOver + `closeAfterGameMs` (60 s) is the ceiling.
- A drop in phase 'over' now holds the seat until `closeAt` (`holdSeatAfterGame`) instead of nulling it.
- A player who was away at the end, coming back by token or by code within 60 s, gets the finished snapshot and the solution. When everyone has had the end, an empty room still closes about 1 s later, as before.
- Header comment updated.

DOCS
- 01-SPEC: §12 has a new block on the move to the results (hold, modals, fallback). §16.2 has an "after the end" block on the room lifetime and no reconnect. §18 adds a `solution` row. No §24 row: no D-number, as DECISIONS says.

- QA-CHECKLIST: rows 11, 18, 25 and ניצחון בנטישה updated, plus a new "המסך לא נטען" row.
- STAGE9-10-DEVICE-CHECKS: new check 2ב, plus a Crashlytics note.
- motion.md: new `game.end` row, an implementation note on `lock.release`, and a surrender timeline line.

item: retire-rating: leave guards for surrender and abandonment (D32/D8 amended by Moshe, 2026-10-15)
summary:
Moshe's rule is built in the engine, checked on the server, shown on mobile and written into the docs. It uses the defaults from DECISIONS.md.

**Engine**
- **Rules:** RatingRules has three new fields: leaverGuard (true), stayerGuard (true) and abandonJudgedAt ('disconnect').
- **When a leaving is judged:** PlayerState.leaveStandings holds a snapshot by seat: [score, correct+mistakes] for every player.
  - evolve takes it at playerSurrendered.
  - It takes it at playerDisconnected with `??`, so the first loss event wins.
  - playerReconnected deletes it.
  - playerAbandoned keeps the disconnect snapshot under 'disconnect' and takes a new one under 'graceEnd'.
  - The helper standingsOf is exported.
- **results.ts:**
  - New exports leaverGuardReason, stayerGuardReason and leaveGuardsFor(state).
  - A pair is judged by its first leaver (the lower outOrder).
  - (a) gives the leaver 'noLoss' ('leftBeforeMoving' / 'leftNotBehind').
  - (b) gives the stayer 'noGain' ('opponentLeftBeforeMyMove' / 'opponentLeftAhead').
  - eloInput passes the guards.
  - One helper, penaltyFor, waives abandonPenalty when (a) holds against everyone still in the game. ratingChangesFor and ratingPairsFor both use it.
- **elo.ts:** new types LeaveGuardReason and PairGuard, plus EloPlayer.guards? and RatingPair.guard?.
  - pairPart clamps a pair to a literal 0 and reports which guard held it.
  - eloChanges uses Math.round(sum) || 0, so there is never a −0.
  - eloPairs fixes held pairs at 0 and leaves them out of apportionTenths. The apportioning respects each pair's sign bound, and only held pairs carry `guard`.
- **view.ts:** GameView.leaveGuards is new. It lists the opponents a surrender now would cost me nothing against. It is null outside ranked games, for a spectator, once I am out, or with leaverGuard off.

**Server**
- No logic change: it stores the engine's result, and games still gets +1 even when the change is 0.
- Comments are updated in store.ts, records.ts, service.ts and xp.ts.
- Three tests were reworked: wire.test (4 players, now with a surrender and a disconnect still in its grace), persistence.test and fourPlayers.e2e.

**Mobile**
- surrenderRatingEstimate replaces surrenderRatingDelta and returns {delta, guard}. surrenderCostsNothing is new, for 3–4 players.
- RankedSurrender takes the props `rating` and `noLossMany`. A guarded body is muted text with no red Teko number.
- connectionModel has a new OpponentLeftModel.ratingGuard. OpponentLeft shows a 0 muted, with a reason line that is also in the chip's accessibility label.
- resultsModel has new fields RatingPairRow.guard and ResultsModel.ratingGuards, for any number of players.
- ResultsVersus RatingSection gets one caption per guard (testID results-rating-guard-<id>), also in its accessibility label.
- A 0 is muted in the rating card, the pair rows, the ranking rows and the HistoryCard.
- New strings in he and en (game.json, history.json). The fixture got leaveGuards: null.

**Docs**
- 01-SPEC:
  - §11.2: the full rule, with Moshe's quote.
  - §6.6: a pointer to §11.2.
  - §12: the explanation line.
  - §18: the gameOver row.
  - §24: D32 '✓ … (החלטת משה 2026-10-15); אי־הגעה וקנס: ☐', and the D8 note.
- DECISIONS-PENDING: 2.12 wording, the D8 row in 3.1, and a new item 2.16 with seven open sub-decisions (☐). The section 2 count is now 16.
- QA-CHECKLIST: rows 18, 19 ×3 and "ניצחון בנטישה".
- STAGE9-10-DEVICE-CHECKS: check 2 step 4, a new step-5 guard check, the check-6 example caveat, and the abandonment note.
- components.md §14.1: the "No rating lost" variant.

deviations: PlayerState.leaveStandings is optional and absent when there is no snapshot (`leaveStandings?: LeaveStanding[]`), not `| null` as the design says. A reconnect `delete`s the key on the event's own draft copy. The reason is the snapshot budget: 4 players with two leavers measured 4021 B with null keys and 3989 B without them, against 4096. This leaves room for the grace item's new fields. An older snapshot without the key reads the same way.

The new pending-decisions item is DECISIONS-PENDING 2.16 (section 2, 'hard to change once there are players and ratings'), not a section-3 item. The black-screen item had just taken 3.25. The section-2 count is now 16, and spec §11.2 points to 2.16.

surrenderRatingEstimate returns null when the view has no ratings at all (a development room), even when a guard holds, so an unrated game never says 'הדירוג שלך לא ירד'. As designed, a guarded estimate still needs no rating entry in my account. surrenderCostsNothing is false for unrated games too.
Both optional parts of the design are built: the 3–4 player body `connection.surrender.bodyManyNoLoss` (via surrenderCostsNothing and RankedSurrender's `noLossMany`), and a muted 0 in HistoryCard.
The OpponentLeft reason line is hidden from screen readers and appended to the chip's accessibility label with the screen's sentence separator ('. '), so it is spoken once.
RankingSection delta texts got testIDs `results-ranking-<id>-delta` for the muted-0 test.

Tests that belong to other items were adjusted because their scenarios had leavers with no move: rankedEnd.test.ts (the `over()` helper got an `iMoved` option, used for the 'my change is a gain' test), ranked.e2e.test.tsx (playAndWin has me place one right digit before Nina surrenders), GameScreenGroup.test.tsx (my surrender before any move in a rated 4-player game now shows the no-loss body).
openIssues: Needs a server deploy before an APK relies on it, because the rating is computed on the server. An old server with a new app makes the surrender dialog promise 'הדירוג שלך לא ירד' while the server still applies the loss. A new server with an old app shows the 0 without the explanation. ENGINE_VERSION and PROTOCOL_VERSION were not bumped (left for integration). The new fields are additive.

Open sub-decisions are listed for Moshe in DECISIONS-PENDING 2.16, all built per the recommendation: the judging moment for an abandonment, equal scores, whether a held game counts in `games`, XP and wins by place, the abuse threshold, the abandonPenalty waiver, and clamp vs void under D36 byScore.
Abuse risk as in the design: one quick right digit, then an immediate surrender, means a weak player loses nothing to a strong opponent ahead. No threshold was added, following Moshe's wording.
Snapshot budget: 3989 of 4096 B for 4 players with two leavers. The grace item's new per-player fields must fit in about 100 B, or the snapshot encoding needs a rethink.
Device check: STAGE9-10 check 2 step 5 has the new guarded cases for Moshe's phones.
notesForOtherItems: GRACE item, the snapshot: evolve's playerDisconnected does `p.leaveStandings = p.leaveStandings ?? standingsOf(s)` (standingsOf is exported from packages/engine/src/game/evolve.ts). A new soft-loss event (playerConnectionLost) should take it the same way, so the FIRST loss event wins and the hard phase keeps it. playerReconnected does `delete p.leaveStandings`, and any new 'back' event must do the same. playerAbandoned keeps the snapshot under abandonJudgedAt 'disconnect' and retakes it under 'graceEnd' or when none exists.

GRACE item, the type: PlayerState.leaveStandings is OPTIONAL and absent when there is no snapshot. It is not null, to save snapshot bytes. A 4-player snapshot with two leavers is 3989 of 4096 B (wire.test asserts it), so new per-player fields have about 100 B left. Prefer optional keys over `: null` defaults.
GRACE item, scores: soft-phase moves that count only on return don't touch the leave snapshot, which is taken at the loss.

Engine API: RatingRules has leaverGuard, stayerGuard and abandonJudgedAt; DEFAULT_RATING_RULES and any test 'defaults' object must include them. Old stored configs lack them, which reads as guards off. New engine exports: LeaveStanding (game/types), leaverGuardReason, stayerGuardReason and leaveGuardsFor (game/results), standingsOf (game/evolve), LeaveGuardReason and PairGuard (rating/elo). EloPlayer.guards? and RatingPair.guard? are new; eloChanges and eloPairs deltas are never −0 now.
GameView.leaveGuards is a new REQUIRED field (null outside ranked games). Any hand-built GameView needs it; the mobile fixture twoPlayerView and fourPlayerView has `leaveGuards: null`.

Tests that need a normal ± rating after a surrender or abandonment must have both players place a digit first, with the leaver behind. Otherwise the guards give 0. A leaver with no move, or one who is ahead, gets 0.

Mobile: OpponentLeftModel has a new required `ratingGuard`. RankedSurrender's `ratingDelta` prop is replaced by `rating: SurrenderEstimate | null` plus `noLossMany?`. surrenderRatingDelta was removed; use surrenderRatingEstimate and surrenderCostsNothing. ResultsModel has a new `ratingGuards`, RatingPairRow has `guard`, and RatingSection takes a `guards` prop.
Mobile connection test helper (apps/mobile/src/screens/game/connection/testing/games.ts): RankedGame now has solve(playerId) and miss(playerId) on the first empty cell.

Rating-refresh item: a guarded 0 still produces a RatingChange (delta 0), and the server still adds 1 to games, so storedIn and expectsStored work as they are. A test in rankedEnd.test.ts covers it. The `over()` helper there has a new option, `iMoved`.
